verdict.rationale: Postmark's Domains API explicitly supports generating/verifying DKIM, SPF and Return-Path records and rotating DKIM keys, and sender-signature/domain management docs cover the end-to-end setup exposed via API (postmark-docs-49, postmark-docs-50, postmark-docs-20, postmark-docs-44, postmark-docs-26). However, DMARC is only offered as a separate paid 'DMARC monitoring' add-on rather than an integrated record-generation/verification step alongside SPF/DKIM (postmark-docs-25, postmark-docs-40, postmark-docs-63), so the full SPF+DKIM+DMARC verification loop via one API isn't clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit DMARC record generation/verification endpoint and API-exposed DMARC status alongside SPF/DKIM, and independent confirmation of the verification workflow.
